title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Satellite 6.16 EUS security update
description: Red Hat Satellite 6.16 Extended Update Support (EUS) includes multiple security fixes addressing vulnerabilities in various components such as yggdrasil-worker-forwarder, openvox-server, openvox-agent, puppet-agent, and puppetserver. The vulnerabilities include denial of service, HTTP request smuggling, access control bypass, heap buffer overflow, invalid pointer dereference, and cookie injection via malicious HTTP servers. These issues affect underlying libraries and protocols including gRPC-Go, crypto/tls, Bouncy Castle for Java, jackson-core/databind, Jetty, curl, and golang.org/x/text. The update is rated as Important by Red Hat Product Security and addresses these security flaws to improve the overall security posture of Red Hat Satellite 6.16 EUS.
